title: FOMC communications blackout begins (through 2027-07-29) — the gate whose last day is this book's densest Q2 earnings session
source: EST: established three independent ways by THIS session (2026-09-06) rather than inherited. (1) THE BOARD'S OWN SHADING, DECODED HERE: federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/files/fomc-blackout-period-calendar.pdf re-downloaded direct (HTTP 200, 98,013 bytes), 60 of 122 content streams inflated, the vector grid decoded in-session by tracking the CTM/text matrices -- the 2027 page carries 38 fill rectangles at the legend's grey 0.851 covering 104 day glyphs, which resolve to eight windows of exactly 13 calendar days each: 01-16 -> 01-28, 03-06 -> 03-18, 04-17 -> 04-29, 05-29 -> 06-10, 07-17 -> 07-29, 09-04 -> 09-16, 10-16 -> 10-28, 11-27 -> 12-09. THE DECODER WAS VALIDATED BEFORE IT WAS BELIEVED: run against the 2026 page it returns 01-17 -> 01-29, 03-07 -> 03-19, 04-18 -> 04-30, 06-06 -> 06-18, 07-18 -> 07-30, 09-05 -> 09-17, 10-17 -> 10-29, 11-28 -> 12-10 -- all eight, including the CONFIRMED fomc-blackout-start-2026-09-05 window this calendar already carries. (2) THE POLICY FOOTNOTE, re-extracted verbatim from the same PDF this session: "The blackout period will begin at 12:00 a.m. Eastern Time the second Saturday before a meeting and end at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time the day after a meeting. For example, if the Committee meeting starts on a Tuesday, the blackout period will begin at the start of the Saturday that falls ten days earlier, and if the meeting ends on a Wednesday, the blackout period will end at the end of Thursday." (3) THE ARITHMETIC, applied to the July 2027 meeting read this session off federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 2027 panel "July | 27-28", no SEP asterisk): Jul 27 2027 is a Tuesday, ten days earlier is Saturday 2027-07-17; the meeting ends Wednesday Jul 28, so the window closes at the end of Thursday 2027-07-29. The same footnote applied to all sixteen 2026 and 2027 meetings reproduces every blackout entry this calendar already carries -- 2026-09-05 (confirmed), 2026-10-17, 2026-11-28, 2027-01-16, 2027-03-06, 2027-04-17, 2027-05-29 -- to the day. Filed estimate because a firm rule and a decoded shading are being applied to a TENTATIVE meeting date: fomccalendars.htm states every 2027 date is "tentative until confirmed at the meeting immediately preceding it", so the promotion trigger is the 2027-06-08/09 meeting, not a better fetch. Proposed during the consumer-confidence-2027-07-27 sweep; canonical entry written by its own initial research. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: Ledger: docs/research/events/fomc-blackout-start-2027-07-17.md. WHAT MAKES THIS GATE DIFFERENT FROM ITS SIX SIBLINGS: its last day is the single densest earnings session of the quarter for this book, and that session is inside the blackout. Measured this session from SEC 8-K Item 2.02 filing dates against the fifteen July gates 2012-2026: AAPL and AMZN have printed on the gate's last in-gate session (decision day + 1) in five of the last six completed July gates (2021, 2022, 2024, 2025, 2026; 2023 the exception at +6), MSFT and META print on the decision day itself or the session before, and five of the nine tracked names have printed inside the gate in each of the last three years. Applied to 2027 -- decision Wed 2027-07-28, gate closing end of Thu 2027-07-29 -- that projects AAPL and AMZN onto 2027-07-29, INSIDE the gate. This CORRECTS the proposing entry's own note, which placed them on 2027-07-30 (the first legal-Fed-voice session) under a "+2 sessions after the Consumer Confidence print" reading: the July CB print is the last Tuesday of the month, 2027-07-27, and two sessions later is Thursday 2027-07-29, not Friday 07-30. THE FAMILY'S NEWEST RULE DOES NOT TRANSFER HERE. The May sibling measured June's in-gate overhang at 1.65x its month baseline and 2.63x the following session and called it the widest of the twelve months; on the same construction July runs 1.02x with the overhang out-moving the post-gate session in only 5 of 14 years. The discriminating variable is measured to be the SEP, not the month: pooled across 149 windows 2007-2026 ex-2020, SEP meetings run 1.65x over/post with the overhang larger in 49 of 72, no-SEP meetings 0.94x and 33 of 77 (z = 3.09, p = 0.002), and the ordering survives a within-month control in seven of the eight months that carry both meeting types (December is the one reversal). Every July meeting is a no-SEP meeting. SAMPLE CAVEAT THAT BELONGS ON THE ENTRY: a July FOMC meeting did not exist before 2012 -- 2007-2011 the summer meeting was in August -- so this gate has 14 usable observations against June's 19. NO TOP-TIER US MACRO PRINT IS TRAPPED INSIDE: BLS's own published schedule (bls.gov/schedule/news_release/empsit.htm, HTTP 200 here where sibling runners met 403) stops at November 2026 and bls.gov/schedule/2027/home.htm is a dated 404, so the 2027 dates are derived -- June 2027's report to 2027-07-02 and July 2027's to 2027-08-06, both outside the gate by more than a week either way. SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS THE OTHER RATE ENTRIES: symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is calendar-, rates- or macro-keyed (0 grep hits this session), and the earnings observation above is a single-name SIZING statement, never a direction. Estimate widens caution only; nothing here licenses an entry.
